content: iron-session provides stateless, signed+encrypted httpOnly cookies -- no server-side session store needed, well suited to serverless. Defaults: httpOnly true, secure true, sameSite lax. Requires a >=32-char secret. Cookie size limited to ~4KB so store only IDs (e.g. user id), not full profile/entitlement data, in the cookie -- fetch fresh entitlement from DB per request rather than baking it into the session payload.
